notes.title: Update Notes 01-Jan-2025
notes.notes:
Welcome to the latest update of Tails of Fate demo! We’re thrilled to introduce new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

New Additions:



World Map & Fast Travel:
Introducing the world map for easier navigation and fast travel between key locations.

Quest System:
Added a quest system with a couple of new, engaging quests to explore and complete.

Dialogue System:
Implemented a dynamic dialogue system to add depth and interaction with NPCs.

New Areas:



Hub Area:
Explore a new small hub area filled with opportunities and interactions.

Gameplay Improvements:


 Balance Changes:
Made several balance adjustments to improve overall game experience.
